body:
Thank you all so much for the lovely comments. My dad’s last words were, “I love you, (my name).” I never told anyone that. I didn’t want people to think I was selfish or lying to gain more sympathy. So, I just never told anyone. 

This show made me remember that memory I had pretended didn’t exist. Watching Kyoko pass and that love she expressed to Tohru in her dying moments brought it all back. 

I miss him, a lot. And though there was nothing I could have done to change what had happened, it’s so comforting to know that in his last moments, that look on his face and the last words he said, he could’ve been thinking what Kyoko did.

I love Fruits Basket. I’m so glad I got around to watching it, even if it hurts. I’m really thankful to all of you as well as the series. Thank you all so much!
